Plan a research visit to the University
If you're a research student at another institution, you can apply to spend six months at Bath and carry out your research using our facilities and expertise.
Visiting Postgraduate Scholars
This scheme offers the opportunity for exceptional research students to conduct some of their research in Bath.
Commonwealth Split-Site Scholarship
A guide for Prospective Commonwealth Split-Site applicants at the University of Bath.
Our researchers' stories
Read about the impact our researchers have and find out what they think about being at Bath.
A fascination with chemistry
Bath graduate Dominic Macias stayed on campus for research in his third year rather than go on placement and was inspired to stay on for his PhD.
Lydia's student support story
In this video, PhD student Lydia Hudson explains how the University worked with them on a Disability Action Plan that made all the difference in their studies.
From Undergraduate to Postgraduate: why Tamsyn chose Bath for each stage of her studies.
Final year PhD student Tamsyn Hawken talks about why she chose the University of Bath...and stayed.
We produce papers and patents but the real products of our work are the students.
Dr Antoine Buchard and Dr Ulrich Hintermair from our Centre for Sustainable Chemical Technologies reflect on the impact that doctoral researchers make.
Bath has a great reputation - I've known for years that it would be the place I would apply to.
Emma Williams, studying for a DBA in Higher Education Management, tells why she chose Bath and what it's like combining work and a career.
From world heritage city to the one of the coldest places on Earth
Alex Chartier completed his Engineering doctorate in 2015. Since then he has worked for a top space exploration company and now finds himself at the South Pole.
Doctoral College
If you decide to do your research study here you'll be joining a vibrant and diverse community. Find out more about the Doctoral College and what it's like to be a doctoral researcher at Bath.
Doctoral College
We support and enrich the experience of our doctoral researchers and play a key role in developing policy and strategy relevant to doctoral study.
International students
If you are an international student applying to Bath, find out about visas and other immigration-related information.
Visas
Find out which visa type you need, how to apply, and how our Student Immigration Service can help you with your visa questions.
Experience the University
There are lots of ways you can find out what it's like to live and study in Bath. You can get to know our courses, campus, and students through our postgraduate virtual experience, or meet us at an online event.
Postgraduate virtual experience
Get to know our master's courses, campus and students online.
Experience the University at a Postgraduate Virtual Open Day
Find out what it's like to study for a master's or doctoral degree at Bath at one of our online Postgraduate Open Days.
Virtual campus tour
Take a virtual tour of our campus, including the student accommodation buildings, teaching rooms, laboratories, and Sports Training Village.
Living and studying in Bath
You'll get a great experience living and studying at Bath. You can explore the south west and enjoy life on campus and in the city. We'll support your academic progress and prepare you for your future career.
Things to do in Bath and beyond
Find out what it's like to live in Bath and the South West while you study for your degree.
Finding private sector accommodation
How and where to search for privately rented accommodation in Bath thatâs right for you.
Sustainable Bath
Our journey towards a better future is one we take together. Be part of our whole-institution approach to sustainability.

Important terms and conditions for applicants
Essential legal information for all applicants, including important terms and conditions and requirements.
Postgraduate offer terms and conditions
These are the standard terms and conditions of an offer of a place at Bath, representing the agreement between you and the University.
About us
The University of Bath was established on Claverton Down in Bath in 1966. It is a campus university in the south west of England, and is only 1 hour and 25 minutes away from London by train. We offer courses in engineering, humanities, management, science and social science
